(tsa)༄༅/ /chab shog 'ga' zhig legs par bzhugs so/ /༈/mus chen sems dpa' chen po la phul ba/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpal 'bar bas/ /rab 'ab

tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// chab shog 'ga' zhig legs par bzhugs so// ༈ /mus chen sems dpa' chen po la phul ba// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpal 'bar bas// rab 'byam gzhung la sbyangs pa mi dman zhing*// rgyal ba gnyis pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang 'byor chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung du// khyod kyi zhabs skyes yid 'ongs padmo'i phreng*// gus pa'i cod paṇa rtse la legs bcings nas// yongs su bstan pa'i bka' drin nod pa can// shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos// zhu'o 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig po// snyigs dus rdo rje 'chang dbang de// dag pa'i zhing gzhan spyan 'dren pa'i// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// snying rjes phyug pa min pa snyam// de lta na'ang rje nyid kyi// thugs la 'phos 'dra'i rje btsun khyod// chos kyi srid la dbang bskur bas// brtse ba med pa'i dogs pa'ang bkag /de nas chos kyi rgyal srid che// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel lo zhes// gtam snyan gzi brjid cher 'bar ba'i// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs brgyar g.yo// 'dren pa rdo rje 'chang dbang de'i// gsang ba'i mdzod la spyan yangs pa// khyod kyi dbu la yab nyid kyi// cod paṇa dkar po 'phos gyur tshe// gang gi mdzad pa lhag ma'i khur// ma lus 'degs la ngal ba ci// de bas bdag cag gdul bya yi// lhag mar gyur pa ma lus la// kun khyab thugs rjes ring gzigs nas// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar rigs// zhes pa'i zhu yig mi 'khyar ba'i rten mtshon par gsol ja nyag gsum la rtags 'byar 'bul/ dbo'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i dga' ba dang po la zhu yig/ ༈ //khwa char byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan la phul ba// ༄// lus can kun la dmigs med brtse ba can// shes bya kun la mtha' med mkhyen pa can// lam bzang kun la g.yeng med brtson pa can// bsod nams rgyal mtshan tog ltar mtho ba'i drang*// rnam par dpyod dang dad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser// khyod zhabs padmo'i phreng ba gar mdzad pas// shākya'i bstan la bskal bzang nyer thob pa// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros 'di skad zhu// khyod ni bsod nams yangs pa'i nam mkha' la// rnam mang skye ba'i rta bdun rgyal mtshan rtser// phrin las 'od dmar phyogs brgyar 'gyed do zhes// snyan pa'i gtam des bdag snying dga' ba'i dpal// khyab bdag smra ba'i nyi ma des// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i bcud// gcig bsdus yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gnas// phyogs 'dir sngon med gsal mdzad che// zhing gzhan gzigs pa'i sgra gcan des// mdzad pa'i lhag ma ma zin pa// gling gzhan mun par gyur snyam nas// smra ba'i nyi ma spyan drangs so// kye ma rdo rje'i sku yang ni// skal med mig gi lam du zhig

/'gag med longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gsung*// bdag cag rna ba'i lam du zad// kun la dgongs pa'i thugs rjes kyang*// 'ga' zhig brtse ba'i yul nas dor// la la mi srid srid pa yi// sdug bsngal gyis mnar mnar med 'dra// rje yi gsang ba'i mdzod nyid du// thugs kyis goms stabs 'dor mkhas shing*// gang gis dad pa'i kun dgar yang*// rje nyid rang dbang 'byon gyur pa// khyod cag 'du bral gang la mnga'// de bas khyab bdag nyid kyi bka' dang ni// kun la snyoms pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho'i gter// mnyam du grub pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// bzang po skye dgu'i dpal du zhabs brtan mdzod// ring nas brtse ba'i bka' yi zer// lag pa'i padmor yang yang lhung*// thugs rjes bskyangs so bka' bzhin du// bsgrub 'dod thos ldan bdag kyang ni// gzhung mang bshad pas bstan pa spel ba dang*// lam bzang bsgoms pas rang don grub gyur pa'i// 'dod pas gdungs kyang phal cher le lo can// da dung byang chub bar du thugs rjes skyongs// don gnyer blo gsal yid gzhungs gyur pa dag /legs bshad lhag ma'i ro la cher chags kyang*// bzlog med bka' phreng khyer ba'i pho nya bas// bgrod do yid kyi gshog pa cher bskyod nas// legs bshad mang po'i ngar sgra sgrogs bzhin du// zhabs drung 'o ma'i rgya mtshor dpal 'byor zhing*// ring nas mthong ba'i dge legs gang yin des// myur 'gyogs bar chad med pa'i bkra shis byon// zhes pa'i brtan mtshon par gsol ja nyag gsum 'bul/ dbo'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i dga' ba dang po la tshal dbus gling gi chos grwa nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //kun mkhyen don yod dpal la phul ba// ༄// don yod mkhyen pa kun la 'phro ba dang*// dpal ldan thugs rje thugs la gnas pa dang*// bzang po'i rim gnyis zung du 'brel mkhas pa'i// bka' drin can de dad pa'i gtsug na rgyal// rab rib bral ba'i blo yis dang*// thos la dga' ba'i 'dun pa dang*// khyod zhabs bstan pa'i dad pa gsum// mnyam du tshogs pa'i dpal yon gyis// shākya'i gsung rab phal cher la// rmongs pa phyogs tsam gsal ba yi// mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis mtho ba// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros de// don gnyer tshong pas nor bu'i gling dang ni// ngang pa'i dbang pos 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang*// bung ba'i tshogs kyis pad tshal mthong ba ltar// snying gi dkyil nas khyod kyi rjes su song*// de lta na yang 'jig rten 'dir// kun dang bstun na bcol chung zhing*// ma bstun na yang drin mi bzo// gzhan don ltar snang dag la chags// de phyir re shig gom pa yi// 'dor bstabs bkag la thugs ma chad// tshe rabs gzhan du'ang bla ma yi// zhabs pad mchod par smon byed na// tshe 'dir skal ba yod bzhin du// shes ldan su zhig bsten mi byed// khyod ni klog gam sgrub la brtson kyang rung*// gnas dang sa phyogs gang du bzhugs gyur pa// chab shog pho nyas bka' mchid bgyid nas ni// khyod mnyes bsgrub las gzhan du ma mchis so// zhes pa'i rten mtshon par gsol ja zho gang 'bul// dbo'i zla ba'i dga' ba dang po la tshal dbus gling nas phul ba'i zhu yig/

༈ //chu 'dus mkhas btsun pa la 'phrin du gnang ba// ༄// phyogs las rnam rgyal srid zhi'i dpal// dpal 'byor chu bo stong ldan du// 'dus pa'i chos sde spel la mkhas// mkhas btsun bzang po'i zhabs drung du// du ma'i gzhung shes shākya yi// ming can mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// blo can khyod la 'di skad zhu// zhu ba med cing rab tu dpa'// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// ma pham rgyal bas bsngags pa des// kun dpyod mthong na tshangs pas kyang*// dga' bas rtsibs stong 'bul byed pa'i// bskal bzang rdo rje 'chang dbang po// kun gyi 'dren pa kun mkhyen de// dga' ldan gnas su dga' bas drangs// bzang zhes lha rnams bzang po'i sgras// bstod pas pho nya bstod byed mod// bdag cag yid la me sbar zhing*// lus la ngal ba'i zhags pas bsnun// lce rtser so yi mtshon cha 'bebs// sna nas ring pa'i dbugs 'don zhing*// rna bar mi snyan gtam dang ni// mig nas mchi ma'i rgya mtsho che// 'byin mkhas pho nya de dag ni// rgyal bas bsngags pa yin kyang rung*// bdag cag de la smod pa yi// rig sngags drag tu sgrog par byed// rang cag 'dren pa bor ba yi// sdug bsngal 'di ni lha rnams kyis// mthong nas me tog gsar pa dang*// dbang po'i gzhu yi gur khang dang*// sil snyan rol mos 'drid byed mod// bdag cag 'khrul bar ga la nus// 'on kyang lha mi'i 'dren pa de// lha yi yul du spyan 'dren pa'i// brtson 'grus drag po 'di mthong tshe// lha yi 'dren pa 'dir byon snyam// de lta na ni lha yi lha// rgyal ba gcig yin bdag cag gi /'dren pa sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// de bas rang cag pham mi dgos// yang na chos kyi rgyal po de// de ltar gshegs pa gang la bden// bden na chos kyi rgyal srid 'di// 'di ltar skyong ba'i rje 'di su// su yin the tshom bya mi dgos// dgos pa'i dbang gis gzhan ltar bstan// bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das// 'das pa de yang bden nam ci// de ltar gzengs bstod pa las de// bde ba min las skyes pa'i bde// dga' ba'i sems la skyes pas dga'// re shig de yi dpal la re// yus kyis myos pa'i byis pa'i yus// smra ba thog mar ma la smra// de yis de dbugs dbyung ba de// brjod pa 'di yi dper byas brjod// da ni skabs su bab pa'i don la 'jug par bya ste/

sdom gsum goms stabs brtan pa dang*// mang thos pad mtshor dges pa dang*// brtson pa'i myos bum mtho ldan dang*// brtse bas 'khor la ring gzigs pa// smra ba'i khyu mchog rnams la dgos// thugs rje thugs kyi dkyil du sbed pa dang*// mkhyen yangs mkhyen pa'i 'od stong spro ba dang*// mdzad phrin mdzad pa kun dang bstun pa dang*// bla med bla ma snying nas gus bsten pa// kun nas kun dga'i dpal ster rnams la dgos// rang la yid ches gzigs pa dang*// gzhan gyis dpag nus min pa dang*// brtsad cing dris pas gzhan dag gi /legs spyad phra mo'ang bsdud mkhyen pa// yon tan rgya mtsho kun la dgos// ma 'dris mdza' bshes chen po khyod dang bdag /sngon goms dbang gis yid bcugs gyur pa las// 'dzem med gsol gyis nongs pa gang bgyis de// bzod par rigs so thugs dgongs rnam dag pa// gangs ri'i tog ltar dkar ba'i dge legs kyis// thams cad mkhyen skur ro gcig ma gyur bar// yid bcugs gyur pas phan tshun bag phebs nas// chos dang mthun pa'i bka' mchid bgyid par shog /ces pa'i zhu yig mi 'khyar ba'i rten mtshon par gsol ja nyag gsum la rgya 'byar ba phul/ dbo'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i dga' ba dang po la tshal dbus gling gi chos grwa nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //chu 'dus bdag po 'od zer 'dzom pa la 'phrin du gnang ba// ༄// rmad byung bsod nams 'od brgyas 'khyud pa'i sku// sku gsung zer phreng kun la snyoms pa'i dpal// dpal 'byor 'dzom pa'i lha las 'phos pa'i mi// mi dbang bdag po'i zhabs kyi skyed tshal du// zhu'o shākya'i dge slong mchog /mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis so// bsod nams 'dzin ma'i 'phangs pa na// sku khams rin chen rdul brtsegs dbang*// dbang po'i rdo rje ltar brtan cing*// rang sde gus pa'i cod paṇa rtser// bka' lung gom pa 'dor mkhas shing*// grags pa'i rnga chen cher brdungs pas// gzhan sde dregs pa'i rol mo mkhan// zhum zhing 'jur ba'i dgra thabs mkhan// padmo'i tshal gyis nyi ma'i 'od 'thung bzhin// bzhin mdangs bzang pos sgo gsum dge ba'i las// las gzhan spangs nas gcig tu mdzad// mdzad pa kun las 'di ngo mtshar// mtshar du dngar ba'i gtam snyan de// nam mkha'i pha mtha' lta 'dod dam// 'brug gi sgra de gzhom par 'dod// kun gyi mgrin par gleng gleng nas// mgrin pa'i dpal kun 'dzin par 'dod// sgyu ma chen mo'i pho brang nas// snying rje med pa'i rgyal ba yis// nan gyi bsngags pa'i pho nya des// 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig phrogs pa na// yid la bud shing med na yang*// gdung ba'i me chen cher 'bar zhing*// chu 'dzin gos dang bral na yang*// mig nas mchi ma'i char rgyun 'bab// de lta mod kyi snying khong nas// rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs na// de yi mod la bla ma des// nges par byin gyis rlob 'di'ang mtshar// de nas gzhan yang bsnyad bya ba// gang la grags pa'i gzhi yod na// rang sde 'jam dar che ba dang*// gzhan sde byams pas 'dul ba 'byung*// sbyin 'bras sbyin pas gter du sbed pa dang*// thugs rgyud thugs rjes rtag tu mdzes pa dang*// shes rab shes bya'i gnas la 'jug pa gsum// grags dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i rgyu// yo lang mang pos gzhan sems mgu byas na// yo lang 'dod dgu ngang gis 'phel bar 'gyur// snying rje che la ring du goms byas na// snying po med pa rim gyis spong bar 'gyur// mang thos bag chags chung ngu'ang bsags gyur na// mang po'i shes bya shes par ga la dka'// longs spyod med na yon gyis bslu dgos pa'i// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i yon tan ga la 'byung*// snying rje med na rgyal phran mang po yis// snying nas gus pa'i rgyal por ga la 'gyur// shes bya'i gnas rnams ji bzhin mi shes na// shes ldan mang pos ri bzhin ga la bkur// chos lugs 'di gsum nyid kyis legs grub phyir// chos bshad mkhan gyis nyid la zhu mi dgos// de lta na'ang bzhin bzangs 'ga'// 'ga' yis me long bstan na gsal// gsal dkar gangs ri dkar po'i mdangs// mdangs dkar zla zer dkar na dkar// dkar po'i mdangs can dbyangs can ma// ma ltar brtse ba des gsungs snyan// snyan dngags lugs brgya 'dzin pa'i rab// rab 'byams smra ba de skad lo// legs smon dag pa'i mdza' bas sbrel ba'i mthus// ring mo zhig nas bdag la brtse ba can// mi dbang khyod dang 'o skol rnam mkhyen du// ro gcig bar du dga' bas yid bcugs shog

/ces pa'i zhu yig mi 'khyar ba'i rten mtshon par gsol ja nyag gsum la rgya 'byar 'bul/ dbo'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i dga' ba dang po la tshal dbus gling gi chos grwa nas zhus// ༈ //bzhi sde mkhyen rab pa la gnang ba// ༄// thub bstan gsal ba'i khang bzangs nyams dga' bar// mkhyen rab li khri'i mtshams sprin gar mdzad cing*// sa yi dbang phyug kun gyi ral pa la// zhabs kyi rdul phreng 'god mkhas de drung du// mang du thos pa'i chang gis rab myos shing*// snyoms las bde ba'i mal du gnyid log kyang*// chos ltar snang ba'i rnam g.yeng mang po can// shākya mchog ldan zhes byas ring nas zhu// deng sang sku yi lhun po 'gro ba'i dpal du zhabs brtan zhing bsod nams kyi rgya mtshor brjid chags/ phrin las kyi 'od zer mdangs gsal zhing lhun gyis grub par 'jug thugs kyi rgya mtsho la rnyog pa mi mnga' zhing rim gnyis kyi rba rlabs bzang pos rtag tu mdzes/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa rnams ni byams pa'i thugs kyis skyong bar mdzad do// zhes grags pa'i pad dkar phyogs kun gyi dpal mo'i rna bar 'chang zhing mdzes pas thugs la btags/ bdag kyang khams bzang ba'i ngang nas 'chad nyan la brtson pa'i lugs su yod lags/ sngar legs 'byor grogs mched gnyis la thugs rjes bzung zhing dus mchod la 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad pa rnams chud ma zos par rnam par dag pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu phul zhing de thog tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ smon lam rnam dag gis rgyas btab pa'i rgyu mtshan 'khod pa'i zhu yig brtson 'grus dpal dang khwa char dbon po ba gnyis la snga phyir phul ba phyag tu thengs lags sam/ skabs kyi zhu don ni/ sngar yang thugs rjes yang dag bzung ba'i stobs kyis da lan don 'di zhu bar rngo mi thogs kyang*/ dpal 'byor 'bras bzang yang yang bstsol mkhas pa'i// dpag bsam ljon pa'i phyogs su skye dgu 'di// yang yang gom pa 'degs la ngal ba ci// de phyir slar yang don 'di zhu ba lags// phag lo'i nang gi dus mchod de/

nged rang gi grwa tshang la 'khor ba mang yul tshun chad du 'bul ba phran tshegs zhu ba la gnas sgo ba dge 'dun 'od zer grogs mched rdzangs pa lags pa/ de nas kyang sku rim gyi gsal 'debs dang*/ dge rgyun rnam par dag pa la dgongs nas/ dus mchod kyi cha rkyen la phan pa'i gnang sbyin rgya chen dang*/ khong grogs mched kyi mgo 'don du 'gyur ngo shes pa thugs rjes 'dzin pa zhu/ slad ma yang zhu yig gi ngang nas mjal ba byed lags/ zhes pa'i brda' mtshon par ja bzang po lha sa'i zho gang la dam rgya 'di 'byar pa 'bul/ zhib zhu ngag nas 'bul/ sa gas nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi la/ dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi bsti gnas chen po nas phul ba'i yig/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bzhi sde slob dpon rnam rgyal ba la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ brgya byin thod kyi nor bu la// rab 'khod sen mo'i dmar 'od ni// 'char kha'i mdangs kyis nyer 'khyud pa'i// thub dbang de yis khyod bsrungs shig /dus min dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*// dpal ldan phrin las bzang po ni// nyer stsol zla ba'i zhal ldan ma// bcom ldan de yis khyod la bsrungs// rnam dkar yid kyi ri mo ni// rab gsal shog bu'i me long la// rab 'phos legs phrin bung ba ni// sim byed tsandan dri 'od can// bar chad med par 'dir 'ongs nas// phyogs phrag sor mo'i 'dab ma dang*// 'dzum phreng ge sar g.yo ldan pa'i// yid kyi pad mtshor de babs so// de nas slu med dkon mchog gsum// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kyis// snyom las med par khyod bsrungs zhes// shis brjod snyim pa bskang nas phul// zhes pa'i rten mtshon byed bgrang phreng lo shas bgyis pa'i tshe yang gi phreng ba brgya rtsa gcig la phyag rgyas btab pa phul/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la thub bstan dar rgyas gling nas phul// ༈ //yang de nyid la gnang ba// ༄// dbon po rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i yi ge

de nang du shar ba'i rten dang bcas pa ma nyams par 'dir 'phrod pas rjes su yi rang*/ yum sras pa ni ning 'o rgyal zhing sku nyen che ba gcig byung 'dug na'ang*/ sku ngo bo la nyes pas ma gos pa byung gda' ba/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*/ chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams kyis bsrungs skyobs la g.yel ba mi mnga' ba'i mthu dang nus pa yongs su grub pas 'dir yang spro ba 'phel zhing bsngags gsol dang*/ gtang rag gang lcogs la 'bad pa bgyis/ slar yang nyid kyi sku rim dang bsrung 'khor la mi g.yel bar bgyid pa yod/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bo dag la ni tshe rabs gzhan du ma zad 'dir yang*/ chos skyong bsrungs ma rnams kyis yal bar 'dor ba ga la srid/ de nas nyid la legs par bshad pa'i gtam du bya ba ni/ skyabs mchog gsum la gcig tu gzhol gyur na// skyabs gzhan dag la ltos pa'i go skabs bral// skyabs kyis skyob khyod yid gnyis ma za bar// skyabs gnas bzang po'i phyag la bde bar 'jus// mang thos cha shas nyung du'ang bsags gyur na// mang po'i shes bya shes la thogs pa med// kun la bag yod gtam gyis mgu byas na// kun gyis bkur ba'i rgyal por gdon mi za// rigs dang brgyud pa'i chos lugs bsrungs byas na// rigs bral gzhan gyis 'gran pa'i go skabs ci// gzhon nu'i dus nas bslab sbyangs mang mdzad na// gzhon nur gyur pa'i sku dang mnyam par nges// yab dang yum gyi bkur bsti ma nyams na// yab mes gong ma'i chos skyong bsrungs mas skyob// yid gcugs gyur pas khyod la bag phab pa'i// snying gtam yid kyi zlos gar 'di longs shig /ces pa'i mtshon byed du gos chen dmar smug kha gang gi phyi thum la the'u 'byar ba 'bul/ zhib cha cung zad gcig dge slong dge 'dun grags kyi ngag nas 'bul bar yod lags/ hor zla lnga pa'i yar tshes la thub bstan gser mdog can gyi dben gnas dam pa nas phul//

//maṅga laṃ// bha wantu// shu bhaṃ// ༈ //bka' shog rin po che'i skyes bcas/ gaṇḍi bzang po/ gaṇa dbyug dang zung du 'brel bas dge legs su bya ba rnams/ nyams chag med par phebs shing 'phrod pa la/ 'di skad ces/ ngo mtshar chos kyi sgra dbyangs lhur len zhing*// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i sde chen bsdu ba la// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga chen po// de yi rnam dkar phrin las rgyas mdzad shog /rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// lha rnams dga' ba'i chos gsung rgyal ba'i sras// dam chos 'dus pa'i 'phrin las bzang po can// gang de'i bstan bsrungs rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis// dpal ldan rigs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams shing*// chos dang srid kyi chu chen bzhi 'dus pa'i// ya mtshan sde chen 'dzin zhing skyong mdzad po// bsrung zhing skyob la g.yel ba med mdzad shog/ //yang chu 'dus pa'i chos rje sangs rgyam la gnang ba ni// rje btsun dam pa chos rje'i drung*// shākya'i sras kyi klog pa pas// zhu ba mol mchid rgyas btab pa// stod g.yogs thags bzang kha dog can// rnam dkar dgongs pas springs gyur pa// rigs par 'phrod pas yi rang zhing*// de las 'khrungs pa'i rnam dkar ba// dri mas sbags pa lta ci 'tshal// mtshan mar 'dzin pa las grol ba// de yi 'bras bu rnam gsum las// rgyu mthun sku stod seng ge ltar// rab rgyas dbu 'phangs gong mthor byed// der yang ma zad chos smra la// yang yang sbyin par mdzad la spro// rnam par smin pa lha yul du// lha rdzas na bza' 'bum phrag gis// 'tsho zhing gang du gos bzang dang*// bcas te 'khrungs par 'gyur ba lags// bral ba'i 'bras bu 'gro mang gi /ched du yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// nyid kyi go 'phangs don du zhes// bsngo zhing smon par mdzad 'tshal lo// deng sang 'di na chos smra nyung*// chos smra las kyang 'jig rten gyi// gzhung lugs rnying pa 'dzin byed dkon// la la rang nyid btsongs pa yi// rin gyis mnga' ris yangs po 'dzin// 'ga' zhig mna' gzhung bzang po yis// rang rang dbang ba'i bgos skal spyod// gya gyus mthon por son pa yi// g.yang sa gting dpag bsrungs par dka'// mna' gzhung bzang po'i them skas la// rim gyis 'dzeg pa'i go 'phangs brtan// sngon bsags 'byor ba'i rgya mtshor yang*// bsod nams char chen ma phebs na// lce brgya rkyong ba'i chu 'dzin gyis// nyin bzhin blangs pas zad par sla// mchod dang sbyin pa'i mtsho rlangs ni// dmigs med mkha' la thim gyur kyang*// mgyogs par rgyu mthun sprin rum nas// 'byor pa'i char chen myur du 'bebs// g.yo dang phrag dog mi mnga' ba'i// 'jig rten pa dang chos pa dkon// g.yo med bgyi la tshul bzhin du// lhod pa med de nyi ma bzhin// phrag dog zer gyis ma gtses pa'i// chos pa'i zla ba cha shas gang*// gzhung lugs gnyis po rang rang gi

/tshul bzhin skyong la lha min gyi// dpung tshogs dgra bor langs gyur kyang*// thub par dka' ba lha dbang bzhin// go 'phangs mthon por gnas pa'i rje// rnam dpyod bzang dang brtson 'grus kyis// mkhas btsun bzang po'i bya ba las// nam yang nyams par ma byas na// 'jig rten lugs kyi phun tshogs ni// rgya mtsho che la chu bo dang*// mchog grub pa na thun mong gi /dngos grub ngang gi 'du ba bzhin// zhes pa'i zhu mchid legs bshad kyi// tshig 'ga'i skyes dang bcas pa la// mdzangs pa'i thugs kyis mi khrel bar// brtse ba'i phyag gis bzhes par zhu// // ༄༅// byang chub thugs kyis rgyud sbyangs shing*// lung rigs gnas la nges byang ba// 'gro kun dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal// phrin las bzang por gyur de'i drung*// shākya'i sras kyi bsod snyoms pas// gcom bskyungs nas ni mchid shog gi /lan du mchid phrin akṣa ra'i// pho nyas bsrings pa 'di zhu'o// gang der nyes pa'i 'tshe bral zhing*// yon tan tshogs rnams yar ngo yi// cha shas gter bzhin rab gang ba// de la nges par rjes yi rang*// gang 'dir ldan dang 'du ba yi// 'tshe med lus ngag yid gsum yang*// thugs rje che ldan ston pa yi// bstan pa rgyas pa'i don du bsngos// gang der lang tsho'i ljon phreng ni// rnam dpyod me tog cher 'bar ba// de'i dus su thos bsam gyi// 'bras bu'i khur chen de bzung shig /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa yi// mdzod 'dzin dam can tshogs rnams kyi// khyod kyi bzhed pa'i don de dag /bsgrub la g.yel ba med gyur cig /gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra bo yang*// chos kyi skyes mang dang bcas nas// bar chad med par 'dir byon pa// sngon gyi dam bca'i khur khyer nas// bden pa kho na bsrung byed ces// rigs pa'i lam du gegs med par// bde bar son pa de bsnyen nas// ring du bsti ba'i cho ga yis// rigs pa'i gnad rnams len pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgyan drug gi

/gzhung mang shing rta'i srol ji bzhin// dar zhing rgyas pa'i thabs dang ni// rten 'brel ma lus 'grig par shog /chab shog rten dang bcas pa yang*// bar chad med par 'dir 'byor bas// de don nges par sems pa dang*// blo la ljen zhing gshin par bgyid// bdud rtsi'i phur ma nyung zad la// phyag rgyas btab pa 'di phul ba// gser mdog can gyi nags khrod nas// mgo yi yar tshes bco lnga la'o// // ༄༅// shrī mchog tu ma pham pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du/ akṣa ra'i lam nas nye bar 'ongs pa'i mchid phrin du zhu ba/ gang nyid 'tsho zhing bzhes la/ mang du gsan pa dang*/ spong ba dang sgom pa la mngon par dgyes par lhur mdzad pa la g.yeng ba mi mnga' bar gdan chags sam/ slar yang snga mkho las gzhan du mi g.yel ba'i bgyi ba lhur 'tshal ba kho na nyid zhu/ 'di na'ang*/ le lor gyur pa'i stan 'jam po las skyod ldang ches yang bar gyur pa ma mchis na'ang*/ lhan cig gnas pa'i tshogs la rjes su bstan pa nye bar 'doms pa la mngon par dga' bar mi 'dor ba'i mal tsam du mchis/ zhes zhu ba'i brda mtshon du/ sbyor chung cig la rgya 'byar 'bul// zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la phul ba'i zhu yig/ // ༄// na mo wā gi shwa rā ya/ dam chos chos bzhin smra bas mang po'i rje// mkhas kun kun nas dga' bas phyogs rnams las// rnam rgyal rgyal bas bstsal ba'i dge mtshan gyis// ring du 'tsho zhing zhing 'dir dge legs shog /rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan dkar ba// mang du gsan pa'i spyan dkyus dang*// rnam dpyod phyag ring rkyong mdzad pas// rigs par spring pa'i mchid shog dang*// gang 'di'i legs byas phra mo la// nye bar song pa'i thugs brtse yi// 'od dkar ring du ma 'khyam par// rab mtshon skyes dang bcas te phebs// 'di na yum chen rnam pa bzhi// cha mnyam de bzhin gshegs pa lnga// snyoms las bde ba'i ros mchod cing*// la lar legs bshad rol mos kyang*// snyan grags rab gsal blo gros nyin byed stong gi zer 'phro ba'i// che rnams kyis kyang rtogs dka'i sde snod dgongs don gting zab par// ma mtha' rtogs byed rnam dpyod sgron ma 'bar ba'i kha lo pa// nye bar bsnyen pa'i lhag bsam zla gzhon gong nas gong 'phel spyon// ces pa yongs 'dzin 'gram pa las// rab 'khrungs dpag bsam thang chu yi// thigs pa sa la smin gyur pa'i// phur mar phyag rgyas btab pa 'bul//

༈ //nyug rgyal khang du nang so grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ba// ༄// nang so'i drung du/ zhu ba/ gsung shog rten ldan rim pa gnyis su phebs pas thugs rjes bzung lags/ de skabs kyi zhu lan 'gyangs pa la thugs kyis mi bas par zhu/ zhes drang srong chen po'i rjes su 'jug pa dag gi legs par bshad pa'i skyes su bgyi ba'i mtshon byed ni/ skabs der mā li kā phreng dag /mgul par 'chang zhing zla ba yi// 'od zer cod paṇa rtser bzung ba'i// dbyangs can zhal gyi sbrang rtsi dge /rgyal po khyod kyi rnam dpyod ni// lugs gnyis blta ba'i mun pa dang*// mthar byed pho nya'i zhags pa dang*// phra dog rtsub mo'i lam las kyang*// lus med kyis 'phangs me tog mdas// lang tsho can gyi yid g.yo byed// mkhas pa'i legs bshad mda' gcig gis// blo gsal yid kyi shing rta yang*// gang khyod lugs brgya blta ba yi// blo gros ngal ba des ci bya// nges don sbrang rtsi gcig myong na// rmongs pa'i mun chen kun la grol// kun la bzod pas sran tshugs na// 'jig rten pa kun dga' ba skyed// lang tsho ldan pa'i mdzes sdug gis// kun gyi yid rab 'dzin min nam// khyod kyi mkhyen dang nyi ma yi// khyad par nyi ma mkha' la 'gro// khyod blo rig gnas gzhung brgya las// gzhan du 'pho ba ga la srid// sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa'i lang tsho can// dar la bab pa'i pad mtshor rol// res 'ga' dzā ti'i me tog kyang*// dga' bas dang du len min nam// dngul dkar gsal ba'i me long can// ga bur gzhon nu'i bla gos dang*// tsandan byug spos kyis bsil ba'i// khengs ldan ma 'di gnyis skyes kyi// dbang phyug nyid dam yang na ni// rab dkar ngang mo utpal gyi// phreng 'dzin and+ra rnyil gang gi /chu gter dwangs pa'i dbus bzhugs pa'o// //thos dang bsam dang sgom dang dge /'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa 'di// snang bzhin stong ngo stong bzhin snang*// dgyes phyir phul lo phul phyir dgyes// zla ba'i zhal can sngo sangs ma// mtshan mor gyur nas bzhin gsal ba// gang 'di'i mdza' bo bde 'byung gi

/gtsug rgyan bsil ba min pa'ang yod// gser gyi ri bo'i shing rta la// rab zhon rgya mtsho'i bang rim can// phyogs phrag phyogs su bskor byas pas// snang byed dgra bo drungs phyin no// de ltar gzugs can gsal byed dang*// skor ba can dang 'gog pa dang*// don gzhan bkod dang ldog pa can// bsdus dang phul byung rgyan rnams kyis// rnam gsal dper brjod re re dang*// sgra dang gab tshig rgyan gyi yang*// rnam gsal dper brjod re re 'bul// gangs can 'di na dbyangs can gyis// rjes bzung rnams kyi bstan bcos ni// ngag gi dbang phyug la dga' ba'i// 'dod pa 'jo ba'i khyu mchog yin// zhes 'di gser mdog 'dzin pa yi// drang srong dbyangs can la dga' bas// grags ldan dben shrī'i gdung 'dzin gyi// spyan zung 'dzin pa'i dpal du phul// khrums kyi nya gang ba'i yar tshes drug la/ gser mdog can nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ //maṅga laṃ// //bha wantu// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
